description: This file defines a template class 'Ril_queue' for managing request queues in a radio interface layer (RIL) context, including methods for enqueueing, dequeueing, checking if empty, and checking/removing specific requests based on message ID and token. It includes synchronization primitives for thread safety.

classes.name: Ril_queue
classes.description: A thread-safe template queue class for handling requests in the RIL socket communication.

methods.name: Ril_queue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes mutex attributes and the queue front pointer.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the first element of the queue, waiting if the queue is empty.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a request to the front of the queue and signals waiting threads.

methods.name: checkAndDequeue
methods.description: Checks for and removes an element with a specific message ID and token, returning 1 if found and removed, 0 otherwise.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty, returning 1 if empty, 0 otherwise.
